config.adjacent_identical: excluded from finite search catalog; canonical physical merges tested separately
config.geometry: normal incidence, coherent planar isotropic, semi-infinite substrate, no backside
config.score: lexicographic (max(0,max(g)),mean(max(g,0)^2),max(g)), then physical layer count/total thickness/catalog tuple; AR g=R/tolerance-1, planted g=abs(R-R*)/tolerance-1
config.search: deferred-restart beam/frontier: retain unselected scored states as backup entrances; expand active beam h layers, evaluate all intermediate layers; frontier candidates are h-step endpoints. No thickness refinement, deletion or material swap.
config.diversity: best by score always retained; choose remaining by farthest Euclidean distance within fixed top 4B score-ranked pool; complex=Re/Im r at common plane; intensity=R at same anchors
config.accounting: no cross-method cache; every unique scored stack physically calls verified TMM plus independent complex Fresnel recursion, each padded to 4 iterations. Padded work equal by budget; active-layer work and wall time reported separately. Oracle and final audits outside search budget and counted separately.
config.oracle_scope: exhaustive finite catalog on fixed training constraints; not a continuous-thickness or continuum-wavelength optimum
